job_information.title: Senior Power BI & AI Developer | Manufacturing & Business Process Expert | Claude Code/OpenAI

job_requirements.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
We are a Dutch Data & AI consultancy looking for a senior developer who can help us build reusable Power BI products and advanced visualizations for manufacturing and industrial companies.

This is not a standard Power BI dashboard role. We want someone who combines Power BI, business/process knowledge and software development, and who is comfortable working with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI.

Examples of products and use cases we want to develop:

* Interactive warehouse maps showing stock and locations
* Factory floor visualizations with machine status
* Production flow and bottleneck analysis
* OEE and downtime dashboards
* Capacity and production planning
* Maintenance and inspection visualizations
* Energy usage per machine or production area
* Quality issues linked to products, machines or process steps
* Interactive HTML/SVG visualizations inside or alongside Power BI

We are specifically interested in solutions that go beyond standard Power BI visuals and feel more like interactive applications or products.

### What we are looking for

Strong experience with:

* Power BI, DAX and Power Query
* HTML, CSS, JavaScript and/or SVG
* Advanced or custom Power BI visualizations
* Manufacturing, warehouse or production processes
* APIs and operational data integrations
* Claude Code, OpenAI or similar AI development tools
* Rapid prototyping and reusable product development

Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, ERP/WMS/MES systems or Python is a strong plus.

We value someone who understands the business process behind the dashboard, can challenge our ideas and can independently suggest better solutions.

We would like to start with one concrete prototype and, if there is a good fit, develop multiple reusable products together.

When applying, please include:

1. Examples of advanced Power BI or custom visualization work
2. Your experience in manufacturing or industrial environments
3. Your experience with Claude Code/OpenAI
4. How you would approach an interactive warehouse map in or around Power BI
</untrusted_participant_content>

job_requirements.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
About the Role
We're looking for a Business Analyst who goes beyond reporting, someone who collaborates with business stakeholders and product representatives to support business decisions. You'll define the metrics that matter, build a deep understanding of the profitability of each of our products, and turn analysis into concrete recommendations. Dashboards are one output of the role, built in our existing BI tool : the core of the job is the strategic thinking and analysis behind them: figuring out what's happening in the business, why, and what we should do about it.

What You'll Do
Act as a strategic thought partner to leadership and product, providing analysis-backed recommendations on pricing, investment, and business strategy decisions.
Define and own core business metrics (CAC, LTV, churn-adjusted recurring revenue, funnel conversion, contribution margin) used consistently across the business, with clear, documented definitions.
Build and maintain per-product profitability analysis, combining revenue, cost of acquisition, and churn-adjusted recurring revenue, validated against Finance's manual reconciliation.
Run deep-dive and ad hoc analysis on the customer journey, marketing spend, pricing, and product performance to identify growth opportunities and risks before they show up in a dashboard.
Partner with Data Engineering to prioritize data sources and models, and to define data quality and completeness requirements from a business-reporting perspective.
Own the accuracy of business reporting end-to-end : validating metric logic against source data, catching discrepancies before stakeholders do, and re-verifying whenever underlying data or definitions change.
Maintain reporting in our existing BI tool (already in place) so metrics stay consistent and trustworthy : reporting is a means to an end here, not the deliverable itself.
Set and enforce a data quality bar for business reporting, including reconciliation checks, sanity thresholds, and clear flagging when a metric shouldn't be trusted yet.
Prepare and present analysis for leadership and cross-functional reviews, grounded in verified, trustworthy metrics you own.

What We're Looking For
- 3+ years in a business analyst, data analyst, financial analyst, or strategy/analytics role, ideally in a product-led or subscription business.
- Business and strategic judgment : comfortable moving from a number to a recommendation, and confident advising leadership on what a finding actually means for the business.
- Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly in a modern data stack (e.g., BigQuery, dbt) to pull and shape your own data.
- Solid grasp of unit economics and profitability concepts : CAC, LTV, margin, churn-adjusted revenue, financial metrics.
- Experience defining KPIs and metrics from first principles, including documenting definitions and edge cases.
- A rigorous, detail-oriented approach to data quality : you double-check numbers before sharing them and treat an unverified metric as a liability, not a deliverable.
- Comfort working in an existing BI tool to maintain reporting, without needing dashboard-building to be the main focus of the role.
- Strong written communication and the ability to distill complex data into a clear narrative for non-technical, senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have
- Experience with payments, subscription, or e-commerce business models.
- Familiarity with marketing attribution and multi-touch customer journey data (e.g., GA4, Google Ads, Amplitude).
- Experience working directly with a data engineering team on data modeling priorities (Bronze/Silver/Gold or similar layered architectures).
- Prior exposure to FP&A or finance workflows.
</untrusted_participant_content>
